gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Round, pen-drawn and unmistakably loud: Turret Road curves like open parentheses. IBM Plex Sans KR follows with openness at every curve end, so a long passage keeps breathing.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Turret Road cuts every letter at a single depth, like an engraver who never pressed harder in places. IBM Plex Sans Thai stays easy underneath.
Turret Road feels like bent pipe cleaner in every letterform, bold and round, with a commanding pull. IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped keeps curves open beneath it.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-imprima: Turret Road gives the top its bold, commanding voice, with round forms that curve like open parentheses and a pen-like line. Imprima's smooth, tube-like lines flare gently at the ends.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-inclusive-sans: Inclusive Sans has round letters whose rims match their stems, and every curve stays open at the end. Under Turret Road's bold display, Inclusive Sans reads like a steady, contemporary sans-serif that never fights for attention.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-inria-sans: Turret Road is bold and commanding, its round forms curving like open parentheses in a pen-like line. Inria Sans does the quieter work, with tubular strokes like bent copper pipe and openings you can see through.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-istok-web: Istok Web reads modern and approachable, rounded with a clearly open side. Turret Road above it is bolder and pen-drawn, and that gap between loud and friendly is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-jost: Clean and professional, Jost sits under Turret Road's bold roundness. Its broad gaps at the terminals and unit-width stroke keep a long stretch of text moving smoothly.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-jura: Bold curves like open parentheses, drawn with a pen-like line: that is Turret Road. Jura holds its strokes as constant as bent wire, so try it at a modest size below the heading.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-k2d: K2D reads clean and neutral, its tube-like thickness holding through every bend. Turret Road is best at commanding attention with round, pen-like forms, while K2D is best at keeping a plain sans line moving.
